oddments.name: Oddments
oddments.desc: General goods. Everything you forgot you needed.

the_forge.name: The Forge
the_forge.desc: The blacksmith. Steel, temper, and opinions about your armor.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.desc: Cures, reagents, and things that shouldn't be mixed.

needles_and_flights.name: Needles & Flights
needles_and_flights.desc: Fletcher. Arrows, bolts, and string for Fenna's customers.

inn_and_tavern.name: Inn & Tavern
inn_and_tavern.desc: Beds, baths, and Murray's cooking. The bathhouse bleeds Sate faster in hot water.

mote_broker.name: Mote Broker
mote_broker.desc: Buys and sells motes. No questions. Fewer answers.

feed_merchant.name: Feed Merchant
feed_merchant.desc: Creature feed. They're picky. Grimley keeps a chart.

books_and_maps.name: Books & Maps
books_and_maps.desc: Maps of places that exist. Mostly.

shrine_keeper.name: Shrine Keeper
shrine_keeper.desc: Lantern supplies. The shrines hand oil to reapers who ask nicely.

the_fence.name: The Fence
the_fence.desc: Black market. Don't ask where it came from. He won't tell you anyway.

creature_stalls.name: Creature Stalls
creature_stalls.desc: The Night Market's creature row. Ivy's stall is at the end. The price is the price.

ferry_stall.name: Ferry Stall
ferry_stall.desc: By the river, in Styx's shadow. Sells to souls who arrived with nothing. Fair prices — the alternative is swimming.

stranger.name: Stranger
stranger.desc: List prices. Nothing beyond the counter.

regular.name: Regular
regular.desc: 5% better prices. They'll hold an item for a day.

friend.name: Friend
friend.desc: 10% better prices. A back shelf, literally. Tab access. A personal quest with a real reward.

partner.name: Partner
partner.desc: 15% better prices. First refusal on rare stock. They'll buy anything. They mention you to other merchants.

haggling.haggle_prompt: Name your price — inside the shown range. One attempt per merchant per day.
haggling.haggle_fail: No. And the look you'll remember. Prices cool until tomorrow.

investing.invest_offer: Invest in [store]? A lump sum. New shelves, better lighting, a second counter. Stock rises permanently. They'll mention you by name to newcomers.
investing.invest_after: The shop looks different. Customers comment. It was your money. It shows.
investing.stall_unlock: Your own stall at the Night Market. Set prices. Hire a minder. The Ledger takes its cut and pretends not to notice the rest.
investing.stall_offer: Five thousand credits. A roped-off patch of dark market floor, yours to work. The Tollkeeper counts it twice and doesn't smile.
investing.stall_after: The rope comes down. The space is yours. It smells like everyone else's ambition.
investing.stall_empty_till: Nothing yet. The dark market owes you nothing, and it's honest about it.
investing.stall_collect: The till. Ninety percent yours. The Ledger took its ten and pretended not to notice the rest.
investing.stall_minder_offer: Fifteen hundred for someone to watch the table while you sleep. They'll double what moves. They'll also eat half your lunch. Fair.

plant_creatures.name: Plant Creatures
plant_creatures.desc: The garden's answer. Rooted, patient, and harder to kill than anything that bleeds.

phoenixes.name: Phoenixes
phoenixes.desc: Rebirth, with interest. What burns doesn't always stay burned.

dragons.name: Dragons
dragons.desc: Apex Presence. Everything else in the field knows it.

strange_animals.name: Strange Animals
strange_animals.desc: Wrong in a way the Ledger can't file. Don't stare. It stares back.

sea_creatures.name: Sea Creatures
sea_creatures.desc: Tidebound: stronger in water and rain, slower on dry land. The river's answer to everything the land grows.

night_market.entry: The Night Market. Everything has a price. Some things have two.
night_market.ivy_sign: The price is the price, little reaper.
night_market.moonfair: The Moonfair. Seasonal. The sixth seat at the judging table is always set, never sat. The wine poured there is always gone by midnight.

feeding.luna_smell_necrolean: Luna drifts close to the {fruit}. "It leans toward Death. Not all the way — but the rot is in it."
feeding.luna_smell_death: Luna pulls back from the {fruit}. "That one is Death through and through."
feeding.luna_smell_eternilean: Luna brightens around the {fruit}. "Light. It leans toward the Light."
feeding.rotted_note: The {fruit} has rotted. Nothing left to eat.
feeding.spore_note: Something took root in you when you ate. It will remember where you fall.
